description: Run an OUTWARD cryptographic discovery scan across an estate and get a CycloneDX 1.6 CBOM. Unlike get_cbom (which inventories already-onboarded integrations), this actively scans real assets: live TLS endpoints, X.509 certificates (PEM) and dependency manifests (requirements.txt, package.json, go.mod, pom.xml). Each discovered algorithm is classified for quantum vulnerability and Harvest-Now-Decrypt-Later (HNDL) exposure, mapped to its recommended PQC replacement (ML-KEM-768 / ML-DSA-65 / AES-256-GCM). Returns a summary, an ordered remediation plan and a scan id. Private/internal endpoints are refused by the SSRF guard.
